content_html:
Are you looking for a destination that has it all? From natural wonders to ancient civilizations, Peru is one of those countries that leaves a mark in the heart of every traveler.. No matter what time of year you come: there is always something impressive to discover.

Here we share 10 reasons why Peru should be on your list of essential trips:

1. Machu Picchu: a wonder of the modern world

The Inca citadel is one of the most visited destinations on the planet. Its energy, history and natural environment make it a simply unforgettable place.

2. A world-renowned gastronomy

Peru has been awarded as the best culinary destination in the world for consecutive years. From fresh ceviche to lomo saltado, the variety of flavors is endless.

3. Unique geographic diversity

Coast, mountains and jungle in a single country. You can surf in the Pacific, walk among the Andes and sail through the Amazon… all in one route.

4. Cultural and ancestral wealth

Pre-Inca cultures, Inca civilization and colonial influence make Peru a country full of living history. The ruins, baroque churches and museums speak for themselves.

5. Landscapes from another planet

From the Paracas Desert to the Vinicunca Mountain (Mountain of 7 Colors), Peru offers landscapes that seem straight out of a science fiction movie.

6. Adventure for all tastes

Trekking, sandboarding, kayaking, cycling, paragliding… if you are looking for adrenaline, Peru is your place.

7. Magical towns and hospitality

The warmth of its people and the beauty of its towns such as Ollantaytambo, Puno or Chachapoyas make each stop an authentic experience.

8. Festivities that mark the soul

Carnivals, National Holidays, Inti Raymi, Qoyllur Riti... the celebrations in Peru are colorful, deep and full of tradition.

9. Sustainability and experiential tourism

Peru is advancing in responsible tourism. You can stay in local communities, learn their customs and contribute directly to their economy.

10. A transformative experience

More than a destination, Peru is an experience that connects culture, nature and emotion.
Traveling to Peru is transformative.
